values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753566 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0', 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0') + https://fwp.mt.gov/binaries/content/assets/fwp/fish/fas/2026-fas-fee-table_adopted.pdf (as previously recorded), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753566 (Restrictions: 'Vehicle Length Trailer Length is 30ft.'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753566 (Restrictions: 'Stay Limit Maximum stay of 7 days'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists a concrete boat ramp, a toilet (type not stated), drinking water and primitive campsites; ADA accessibility rated 'Moderate'.

facilities.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753566 (Facilities: 'Ramp (Concrete)', 'Toilet', 'Drinking Water', 'Primitive Campsite'; ADA Accessibility 'Moderate Accessibility'), read 2026-10-22

note: Montana FWP fishing access site (17 acres, ~4,700 ft) on the Yellowstone River with designated primitive camping, 13 miles south of Livingston on Hwy 89 at milepost 42. FWP notes a 'Steep road into site.' --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page confirms $12/$18 FAS camping, drinking water, toilet, concrete ramp, primitive campsites. Added a 30-ft trailer limit (the page now publishes 'Trailer Length is 30ft.'; the note said none was published) and the 7-day stay limit. Year-round season (manual) unchanged. Not stated: site count, toilet type, how sites are taken (derived FCFS left), hookups (derived electric 0 left). Note corrected (trailer limit) and trimmed of restated facilities, FCFS and fees.
